title: Maharashtra FDA cancels Cipla unit's licence

timeline.title: Maharashtra FDA cancels Cipla unit's licence
timeline.line: The drug sale licence of Cipla's Pune C&F warehouse was cancelled over storage lapses
more: The order, effective Oct 1, follows a revised show-cause notice and a Sept 21 hearing
An earlier August order was withdrawn after a Bombay HC hearing
The FDA seized Reactin Plus stock worth ₹11.19 lakh
